title: Front of House Coordinator
company: University Of Southampton Students Union - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: Front of House Coordinator

Location: Southampton

Salary: Grade 3 - £28,303-£29,339 per annum

Job type: Full Time, Permanent

The Role:
As Front of House Coordinator, you will lead the day-to-day delivery of SUSU's reception service, room and event bookings, and Safety Bus and minibus operations. You will supervise and develop staff, coordinate rotas and operational cover, maintain effective systems and procedures, and work closely with internal teams, students, customers and external partners to provide a welcoming, efficient and high-quality service.

About You:
We are looking for an organised and approachable individual with experience in a senior administrative, business support or front-of-house role.
- You will have experience delivering excellent customer service and coordinating room bookings, events, or activities
- You will have experience supervising staff, managing rotas, and developing efficient systems and procedures to support service delivery
- You will have knowledge of basic financial processes, including quotes, invoicing and timesheets, alongside an understanding of health and safety, equality, diversity and inclusion, and sustainability
- As a confident communicator and proactive problem-solver, you will be comfortable managing competing priorities, working independently and identifying opportunities to improve services and enhance the customer experience
- You will have the flexibility to work across our operating hours, including early mornings, evenings and weekends

Most importantly, you will share our commitment to providing an excellent experience for students, staff, and visitors, and delivering high-quality services across the Students' Union.

About Us:
We are the University of Southampton Students' Union (SUSU) - independent from the University and run by students, for students. Our vision is simple: SUSU is here to enrich the life of every student. We are a workplace that's buzzing with life, ideas, and opportunities - where your work directly shapes the student experience.

As part of our team, you'll enjoy:
- Salary of £28,303-£29,339 per annum
- Generous paid holiday - 24 days per year, plus eight closure days (around Easter, August and Christmas) on top of eight bank holidays (and an opportunity to purchase up to an additional week of holiday).
- Great pension - we contribute 10% into your defined contributions pension scheme.
- Travel perks - discounted UniLink and Blue Star bus passes, a Cycle-to-Work scheme.

Apply Now:
Please use your cover letter to explain why you are interested in joining SUSU and demonstrate how your experience meets the requirements of the role. We would particularly like to hear about occasions when you have led or supported a team, delivered excellent customer service, coordinated bookings or operational activity, and improved a system or process. Please include specific examples and the positive outcomes you achieved.

You can easily apply using your CV and covering letter by clicking on 'Apply Now'.

To know before applying:

Closing Date: Midday, Friday 25 September (Please note that should a high volume of applications be received, the advert may close early, so we would encourage you to apply as soon as possible).

Interview Date: Thursday 8 October.

Regretfully, SUSU is NOT a sponsoring organisation and is, therefore, not able to sponsor you for a visa if you require one (such as Tier 2) to work in the UK.

Please note feedback will not be provided if you are not shortlisted for interview.

SUSU is an equal opportunities employer that values a diverse workforce and we want to reflect the student body that we represent. We value diversity, promote equality and challenge discrimination and will ensure that our recruitment activities are mindful of equality and diversity matters.

Candidates with the relevant experience or job titles of: Front of House Coordinator, Front of House Manager, Front of House Supervisor, Senior Front of House Coordinator, Customer Service Coordinator, Customer Service Supervisor, Customer Service Manager, Reception Coordinator, Reception Manager, Reception Supervisor, Receptionist, Senior Receptionist, Guest Services Coordinator, Guest Services Supervisor, may also be considered for this role.

title: Project Document Controller
description:

An opportunity is available for a Project Document Controller to join a busy engineering and manufacturing environment in Southampton. As a Project Document Controller in Southampton, you will create, maintain and distribute general and technical documentation, working closely with project managers, engineers and external stakeholders to ensure documents are accurate and submitted on time.

About You

- Strong organisational and time-management skills
- Experience with Microsoft Office and general IT systems
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to manage changing priorities and meet deadlines
- Strong attention to detail and accurate record keeping
- Able to work independently with minimal supervision
- Experience in construction, manufacturing or engineering is desirable
- Previous document control experience is desirable

This is a great opportunity for a Project Document Controller looking for their next role in Southampton, working across engineering projects within a collaborative team.

title: Receptionist/Care Navigator
company: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
location: Southampton, SO14 0YG, Southampton, SO16 4XE, Southampton, SO17 2GD, Southampton, SO14 0LT
description: We are looking to recruit a Receptionist/Care Navigator for our busy GP Surgery in Southampton. You will be working as part of a busy team where you will be the first point of contact for all enquiries. You will be answering the phone to patients, professionals and clinicians and will be a key link within the team. The duties are many and varied and include answering the telephone, covering reception, booking appointments, sorting mail and using Systm1 (an electronic patient record), and working with the workflow and back office teams. The role requires a high level of inter-personal skills and personal confidence. Having a respectful and empathetic attitude will be essential, with the capacity to manage sensitive, and confidential information. We are looking for people who have a 'can do' attitude. This is a 6 months fixed term post. We have full time (37.5 hours per week) and part time (18 hours per week) contracts available. The work will involve working in our call centre and on reception at one of our four sites within Southampton. We require somebody with the ability to work a mixture of early shifts with a 7.45 a.m. start and late shifts with a 6.30 p.m. finish. There is also the opportunity to work on a Saturday on a rota basis. Please be advised that you will be working across multiple locations including Royal South Hants Hospital, Adelaide Health Centre, Portswood Surgery and Homeless Healthcare GP Surgery. To work as part of a team to provide a comprehensive and professional administrative support to Solent GP Surgery. Providing a reception service including covering out of hours on a rota basis as required. Answering all incoming telephone calls, booking appointments, dealing with enquiries, and taking messages for staff or providing information to callers as appropriate. Ensuring all new patients complete relevant paperwork, details are inputted onto TPP Systm1 computer database correctly, and that correct procedures are followed regarding patient notes. Deducting patients as appropriate, printing out summaries and photocopying paper notes. Filing and retrieving records as required. Further information about the Trust and this role can be found on the Job Description and Person Specification document attached. We are happy to talk Flexible Working - all requests for flexible working options can be discussed as part of the interview process. It is important to us that we ensure our recruitment processes are accessible and inclusive to everyone - if as a potential candidate you are concerned a person specification may prevent or restrict your application for employment as a result of unintentional barriers on the grounds of your sex, race, age, sexual orientation, religion/belief or disability please initially contact the Trust's Recruitment team - detailed in the advert. The Trust will seek to resolve this issue wherever possible.
